description: Works out the figures a Company Tax Return (CT600) takes, from the open DIYA-GL book of a company: the accounting period, the computation figures, the profit and loss account, and the book's own trading profit and Corporation Tax as a check. Use this when the person asks what their Corporation Tax will be, for their CT600 figures, or how their taxable profit is worked out. It refuses a book that is not a company's, makes a trading loss or carries net non-trading loan relationship debits, and it does not file the return or contact HMRC.
name: derive_company_tax_return
title: Derive a Company Tax Return
